local M = {}
M.line, M.softline = { kind = "line" }, { kind = "softline" }
M.hardline, M.break_parent = { kind = "hardline" }, { kind = "break_parent" }
function M.text(value) return { kind = "text", value = value } end
function M.suffix(value) return { kind = "suffix", value = value } end
function M.if_break(broken, flat) return { kind = "if_break", broken = broken, flat = flat } end

function M.concat(...)
    local children = {}
    local function add(part)
        if not part then return end
        if type(part) == "string" then part = M.text(part) end
        if not part.kind or part.kind == "concat" then
            for _, child in ipairs(part.items or part) do add(child) end
        elseif part.kind == "text" then
            if part.value == "" then return end
            local last = children[#children]
            if last and last.kind == "text" then
                children[#children] = M.text(last.value .. part.value)
            else children[#children + 1] = M.text(part.value) end
        else children[#children + 1] = part end
    end
    for i = 1, select("#", ...) do add(select(i, ...)) end
    if #children == 0 then return M.text("") end
    if #children == 1 then return children[1] end
    return { kind = "concat", items = children }
end

local function forced(doc)
    if doc.kind == "hardline" or doc.kind == "break_parent" then return true end
    if doc.kind == "concat" then
        for _, child in ipairs(doc.items) do if forced(child) then return true end end
    elseif doc.child then return forced(doc.child) end
    return false
end

function M.group(child)
    child = M.concat(child)
    return { kind = "group", child = child, forced = forced(child), mode = false }
end
function M.nest(amount, child) return { kind = "nest", amount = amount, child = M.concat(child) } end
function M.align(child) return { kind = "align", child = M.concat(child) } end

function M.groups(doc, result)
    result = result or {}
    if not doc then return result end
    if doc.kind == "group" then result[#result + 1] = doc end
    if doc.child then M.groups(doc.child, result)
    elseif doc.items then for _, child in ipairs(doc.items) do M.groups(child, result) end end
    return result
end

return M

local M = {}
local keywords, types, doubles = {}, {}, {}
for word in ("int float bool string void if else while for return break continue true false switch case default"):gmatch("%S+") do
    keywords[word] = true
end
for word in ("int float bool string void"):gmatch("%S+") do types[word] = true end
for word in ("<= >= == != && || += -= *= /= %="):gmatch("%S+") do doubles[word] = true end
M.types = types
M.assignment = { ["="] = true, ["+="] = true, ["-="] = true,
    ["*="] = true, ["/="] = true, ["%="] = true }

function M.fail(line, column, message)
    error({ line = line, column = column, message = message }, 0)
end

function M.lex(lines)
    local tokens, comments, items = {}, {}, {}
    local previous = 0
    for row, line in ipairs(lines) do
        local pos = 1
        while pos <= #line do
            local ch = line:sub(pos, pos)
            if ch == " " then
                pos = pos + 1
            else
                local start, kind, value = pos
                local pair = line:sub(pos, pos + 1)
                if pair == "//" then
                    kind, value, pos = "line_comment", line:sub(pos):gsub(" +$", ""), #line + 1
                elseif pair == "/*" then
                    local close = line:find("*/", pos + 2, true)
                    if not close then M.fail(row, pos, "unterminated comment") end
                    kind, value, pos = "block_comment", line:sub(pos, close + 1), close + 2
                elseif ch:match("[A-Za-z_]") then
                    value = line:sub(pos):match("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z_0-9]*")
                    kind, pos = keywords[value] and "keyword" or "identifier", pos + #value
                elseif ch:match("[0-9]") then
                    value = line:sub(pos):match("^[0-9]+%.[0-9]+") or line:sub(pos):match("^[0-9]+")
                    kind, pos = "number", pos + #value
                elseif ch == '"' then
                    pos = pos + 1
                    local closed = false
                    while pos <= #line do
                        local c = line:sub(pos, pos)
                        if c == "\\" then pos = pos + 2
                        elseif c == '"' then pos, closed = pos + 1, true; break
                        else pos = pos + 1 end
                    end
                    if not closed then M.fail(row, start, "unterminated string") end
                    kind, value = "string", line:sub(start, pos - 1)
                elseif doubles[pair] then
                    kind, value, pos = "symbol", pair, pos + 2
                elseif ("+-*/%<>=!()[]{},;.?:"):find(ch, 1, true) then
                    kind, value, pos = "symbol", ch, pos + 1
                else
                    M.fail(row, pos, "unexpected character '" .. ch .. "'")
                end
                local entry = { kind = kind, text = value, line = row, column = start,
                    blank = math.max(0, row - previous - 1), leading = {}, trailing = {},
                    allowed = false, trailing_comma = false }
                previous = row
                items[#items + 1] = entry
                if kind == "line_comment" or kind == "block_comment" then
                    comments[#comments + 1] = entry
                else
                    tokens[#tokens + 1] = entry
                    entry.index = #tokens
                end
            end
        end
    end
    tokens[#tokens + 1] = { kind = "end", text = "", line = #lines + 1, column = 1,
        blank = 0, index = #tokens + 1, leading = {}, trailing = {}, allowed = true }
    return tokens, comments, items
end

return M

local D = require("doc_builder")
local lexer = require("lexer")
local parse = require("parser")
local printer = require("printer")
local report = require("report")
local F = {}
F.__index = F
local C, H, L, SL = D.concat, D.hardline, D.line, D.softline

local function attach(tokens, items)
    local before, next_token, following = false, {}, false
    for i = #items, 1, -1 do
        next_token[i] = following
        if items[i].index then following = items[i] end
    end
    for i, entry in ipairs(items) do
        if entry.index then before = entry
        else
            local after, next_item = next_token[i], items[i + 1]
            entry.own_line = entry.kind == "line_comment" or not next_item or next_item.line > entry.line
            local destination
            if before and before.line == entry.line and (not after or after.line > entry.line) then
                destination = before.trailing
            else destination = (after or tokens[#tokens]).leading end
            destination[#destination + 1] = entry
        end
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(tokens) do entry.had_trailing = #entry.trailing > 0 end
end
local function check_comments(tokens)
    for _, tok in ipairs(tokens) do
        for _, comment in ipairs(tok.leading) do
            if tok.trailing_comma or (comment.own_line and not tok.allowed) then
                lexer.fail(comment.line, comment.column, "comment not allowed here")
            end
        end
    end
end
local function pre_blank(tok)
    return tok.leading[1] and tok.leading[1].blank or tok.blank
end

function F:sep(blank)
    local parts = { H }
    for _ = 1, math.min(blank, self.profile.max_blank_lines) do parts[#parts + 1] = H end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:comments(comments, following)
    local parts = {}
    for i, comment in ipairs(comments) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = comment.text
        local next_entry = comments[i + 1] or following
        if next_entry then
            if comment.own_line then parts[#parts + 1] = self:sep(next_entry.blank)
            else parts[#parts + 1] = " " end
        end
    end
    return C(parts)
end
local function suffix(comments)
    if #comments == 0 then return false end
    local parts = {}
    for _, comment in ipairs(comments) do parts[#parts + 1] = comment.text end
    return D.suffix(table.concat(parts, " "))
end
function F:t(tok, leading)
    return C(self:comments(leading or tok.leading, tok), tok.text, suffix(tok.trailing))
end
function F:split(close)
    local last, own, inline = 0, {}, {}
    for i, comment in ipairs(close.leading) do if comment.own_line then last = i end end
    for i, comment in ipairs(close.leading) do
        local target = i <= last and own or inline
        target[#target + 1] = comment
    end
    return own, inline
end
function F:closing(comments, preceding)
    if #comments == 0 then return false end
    return C(preceding and self:sep(comments[1].blank), self:comments(comments, false))
end
function F:whole(items, ending)
    local parts = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(items) do
        if i > 1 then parts[#parts + 1] = self:sep(pre_blank(item.first)) end
        local doc = self:item(item)
        parts[#parts + 1] = doc
        if item.tag == "function" and not self.first_doc then
            self.first_doc, self.first_name = doc, item.name.text
        end
    end
    if #ending.leading > 0 then
        if #items > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = self:sep(ending.leading[1].blank) end
        parts[#parts + 1] = self:comments(ending.leading, false)
    end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:item(item)
    if item.tag ~= "function" then return self:variable(item) end
    return C(self:t(item.typ), " ", self:t(item.name), self:list(item.parameters), H, self:block(item.body))
end
function F:parameter(item)
    local parts = { self:t(item.typ), " ", self:t(item.name) }
    for _, bracket in ipairs(item.brackets) do
        parts[#parts + 1], parts[#parts + 2] = self:t(bracket[1]), self:t(bracket[2])
    end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:variable(item)
    local parts = { self:t(item.typ), " ", self:t(item.name) }
    for _, dim in ipairs(item.dimensions) do
        parts[#parts + 1] = self:t(dim[1])
        if dim[2] then parts[#parts + 1] = self:expr(dim[2], 0) end
        parts[#parts + 1] = self:t(dim[3])
    end
    if item.equals then
        parts[#parts + 1] = C(self.space, self:t(item.equals), self.space, self:initializer(item.initializer))
    end
    if item.semi then parts[#parts + 1] = self:t(item.semi) end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:initializer(item)
    if item.tag == "list" then return self:list(item) end
    return self:expr(item, 0)
end
function F:list(item)
    local marker = false
    for i = item.left.index, item.right.index - 1 do
        if self.tokens[i].had_trailing then marker = D.break_parent; break end
    end
    local elements = {}
    for _, element in ipairs(item.elements) do
        if element.tag == "parameter" then elements[#elements + 1] = self:parameter(element)
        elseif item.role == "{" then elements[#elements + 1] = self:initializer(element)
        else elements[#elements + 1] = self:expr(element, 0) end
    end
    if #elements == 0 then return C(self:t(item.left), self:t(item.right)) end
    local inner = { SL, elements[1] }
    for i = 2, #elements do
        inner[#inner + 1] = C(self:t(item.commas[i - 1]), L, elements[i])
    end
    if item.role == "{" then
        inner[#inner + 1] = D.if_break(",", "")
        if item.trailing then inner[#inner + 1] = suffix(item.trailing.trailing) end
    end
    return D.group(C(marker, self:t(item.left), D.nest(self.indent, C(inner)), SL, self:t(item.right)))
end
function F:block(item)
    local own, inline = self:split(item.right)
    if #item.statements == 0 and #own == 0 then return C(self:t(item.left), self:t(item.right, inline)) end
    local body = { H }
    for i, statement in ipairs(item.statements) do
        if i > 1 then body[#body + 1] = self:sep(pre_blank(statement.first)) end
        body[#body + 1] = self:statement(statement)
    end
    body[#body + 1] = self:closing(own, #item.statements > 0)
    return C(self:t(item.left), D.nest(self.indent, C(body)), H, self:t(item.right, inline))
end
function F:body(item)
    local prefix = self.kr and " " or H
    if item.tag == "block" then return C(prefix, self:block(item)) end
    if self.profile.add_braces then
        return C(prefix, "{", D.nest(self.indent, C(H, self:statement(item))), H, "}")
    end
    return D.nest(self.indent, C(H, self:statement(item)))
end
function F:simple(item)
    if item.tag ~= "assign" then return self:expr(item.expr, 0) end
    return C(self:expr(item.left, 0), self.space, self:t(item.op), self.space, self:expr(item.right, 0))
end
function F:conditional_statement(item)
    local parts = { self:t(item.keyword), self.keyword_gap, self:t(item.left),
        self:expr(item.test, 0), self:t(item.right), self:body(item.body) }
    if item.else_token then
        local gap = self.kr and (item.body.tag == "block" or self.profile.add_braces) and " " or H
        parts[#parts + 1] = C(gap, self:t(item.else_token))
        if item.alternative.tag == "if" then
            parts[#parts + 1] = C(" ", self:conditional_statement(item.alternative))
        else parts[#parts + 1] = self:body(item.alternative) end
    end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:for_statement(item)
    local contents = {}
    if item.initial then
        contents[#contents + 1] = item.initial.tag == "variable" and self:variable(item.initial) or self:simple(item.initial)
    end
    contents[#contents + 1] = self:t(item.first_semi)
    if item.condition then contents[#contents + 1] = C(L, self:expr(item.condition, 0)) end
    contents[#contents + 1] = self:t(item.second_semi)
    if item.update then contents[#contents + 1] = C(L, self:simple(item.update)) end
    return C(self:t(item.keyword), self.keyword_gap, self:t(item.left), D.group(D.align(C(contents))),
        self:t(item.right), self:body(item.body))
end
function F:clause(item)
    local parts = { self:t(item.label) }
    if item.value then parts[#parts + 1] = C(" ", self:expr(item.value, 0)) end
    parts[#parts + 1] = self:t(item.colon)
    if #item.statements > 0 then
        local inner = { H }
        for i, statement in ipairs(item.statements) do
            if i > 1 then inner[#inner + 1] = self:sep(pre_blank(statement.first)) end
            inner[#inner + 1] = self:statement(statement)
        end
        parts[#parts + 1] = D.nest(self.indent, C(inner))
    end
    return C(parts)
end
function F:switch_statement(item)
    local own, inline = self:split(item.closing)
    local header = C(self:t(item.keyword), self.keyword_gap, self:t(item.left), self:expr(item.test, 0),
        self:t(item.right), self.kr and " " or H, self:t(item.opening))
    if #item.clauses == 0 and #own == 0 then return C(header, self:t(item.closing, inline)) end
    local inner = { H }
    for i, clause in ipairs(item.clauses) do
        if i > 1 then inner[#inner + 1] = self:sep(pre_blank(clause.first)) end
        inner[#inner + 1] = self:clause(clause)
    end
    inner[#inner + 1] = self:closing(own, #item.clauses > 0)
    return C(header, D.nest(self.profile.indent_case_labels and self.indent or 0, C(inner)),
        H, self:t(item.closing, inline))
end
function F:statement(item)
    local tag = item.tag
    if tag == "block" then return self:block(item)
    elseif tag == "variable" then return self:variable(item)
    elseif tag == "simple_stmt" then return C(self:simple(item.value), self:t(item.semi))
    elseif tag == "return" then
        return C(self:t(item.keyword), item.expr and C(" ", self:expr(item.expr, 0)), self:t(item.semi))
    elseif tag == "flow" then return C(self:t(item.keyword), self:t(item.semi))
    elseif tag == "if" then return self:conditional_statement(item)
    elseif tag == "while" then
        return C(self:t(item.keyword), self.keyword_gap, self:t(item.left), self:expr(item.test, 0),
            self:t(item.right), self:body(item.body))
    elseif tag == "for" then return self:for_statement(item)
    elseif tag == "switch" then return self:switch_statement(item) end
    error("unexpected statement " .. tag)
end
function F:last(item)
    local tag = item.tag
    if tag == "primary" then return item.value
    elseif tag == "paren" or tag == "index" then return item.right
    elseif tag == "member" then return item.member
    elseif tag == "call" then return item.arguments.right
    elseif tag == "unary" then return self:last(item.operand)
    elseif tag == "binary" then return self:last(item.right)
    elseif tag == "conditional" then return self:last(item.no) end
end
function F:opened(item, minimum)
    while self.profile.remove_parens and item.tag == "paren" do
        if (item.inner.level or 8) < minimum or #item.left.leading > 0 or #item.right.leading > 0 then break end
        local first, last = item.inner.first, self:last(item.inner)
        if #item.left.trailing > 0 then
            local merged = {}
            for _, comment in ipairs(item.left.trailing) do merged[#merged + 1] = comment end
            for _, comment in ipairs(first.trailing) do merged[#merged + 1] = comment end
            first.trailing, item.left.trailing = merged, {}
        end
        for _, comment in ipairs(item.right.trailing) do last.trailing[#last.trailing + 1] = comment end
        item.right.trailing = {}
        item = item.inner
    end
    return item
end
function F:binary(item)
    local level, operators, operands = item.level, {}, {}
    local current = item
    while current.tag == "binary" and current.level == level do
        operators[#operators + 1], operands[#operands + 1] = current.op, current.right
        current = self:opened(current.left, level)
    end
    local contents = {}
    for i = #operators, 1, -1 do
        contents[#contents + 1] = C(self.operator_break, self:t(operators[i]), self.space, self:expr(operands[i], level + 1))
    end
    return D.group(C(self:expr(current, level), D.nest(self.indent, C(contents))))
end
function F:conditional(item)
    local contents, current = {}, item
    while true do
        contents[#contents + 1] = C(self.operator_break, self:t(current.question), self.space,
            self:expr(current.yes, 0), self.operator_break, self:t(current.colon), self.space)
        local following = self:opened(current.no, 0)
        if following.tag ~= "conditional" then
            contents[#contents + 1] = self:expr(following, 0)
            break
        end
        contents[#contents + 1] = self:expr(following.test, 1)
        current = following
    end
    return D.group(C(self:expr(item.test, 1), D.nest(self.indent, C(contents))))
end
function F:postfix_piece(item)
    if item.tag == "call" then return self:list(item.arguments)
    elseif item.tag == "index" then return C(self:t(item.left), self:expr(item.index, 0), self:t(item.right)) end
    return C(self:t(item.dot), self:t(item.member))
end
function F:postfix(item)
    local reversed, current = {}, item
    while current.tag == "call" or current.tag == "index" or current.tag == "member" do
        reversed[#reversed + 1] = current
        current = self:opened(current.target, 8)
    end
    local segments, calls = { {} }, {}
    for i = #reversed, 1, -1 do
        local operation = reversed[i]
        if operation.tag == "member" then segments[#segments + 1] = {} end
        local segment = segments[#segments]
        segment[#segment + 1] = operation
    end
    for i = 2, #segments do
        for _, operation in ipairs(segments[i]) do
            if operation.tag == "call" then calls[#calls + 1] = i; break end
        end
    end
    local head = self:expr(current, 8)
    if #calls < 2 then
        local parts = { head }
        for i = #reversed, 1, -1 do parts[#parts + 1] = self:postfix_piece(reversed[i]) end
        return C(parts)
    end
    local before, after = { head }, {}
    for i, segment in ipairs(segments) do
        local target = i < calls[1] and before or after
        if i >= calls[1] then target[#target + 1] = SL end
        for _, operation in ipairs(segment) do target[#target + 1] = self:postfix_piece(operation) end
    end
    return D.group(C(before, D.nest(self.indent, C(after))))
end
function F:expr(item, minimum)
    item = self:opened(item, minimum)
    local tag = item.tag
    if tag == "primary" then return self:t(item.value)
    elseif tag == "paren" then return C(self:t(item.left), self:expr(item.inner, 0), self:t(item.right))
    elseif tag == "unary" then return C(self:t(item.op), self:expr(item.operand, 8))
    elseif tag == "binary" then return self:binary(item)
    elseif tag == "conditional" then return self:conditional(item) end
    return self:postfix(item)
end

local function render(lines, profile)
    local tokens, comments, source_items = lexer.lex(lines)
    attach(tokens, source_items)
    local items = parse(tokens)
    check_comments(tokens)
    local formatter = setmetatable({ profile = profile, tokens = tokens, indent = profile.indent,
        space = profile.space_around_operators and " " or "",
        operator_break = profile.space_around_operators and L or SL,
        keyword_gap = profile.space_after_keyword and " " or "", kr = profile.brace_style == "kr" }, F)
    if #items == 0 and #tokens[#tokens].leading == 0 then
        return { lines = {}, comments = comments }
    end
    local document = formatter:whole(items, tokens[#tokens])
    return { lines = printer.layout(document, profile), comments = comments, document = document,
        first_doc = formatter.first_doc, first_name = formatter.first_name }
end
local function format(file, profile)
    local original = {}
    for _, line in ipairs(file.lines) do original[#original + 1] = line:gsub(" +$", "") end
    local ok, first = pcall(render, file.lines, profile)
    file.original, file.diagnostics = original, {}
    if not ok then
        if type(first) ~= "table" then error(first) end
        file.error, file.formatted = first, original
        file.idempotency = file.filename .. ": skipped (syntax error)"
        file.diagnostics[1] = string.format("%s:%d:%d: error: %s", file.filename, first.line, first.column, first.message)
        return file
    end
    file.first, file.formatted = first, first.lines
    local second_ok, second = pcall(render, first.lines, profile)
    if not second_ok then
        if type(second) ~= "table" then error(second) end
        file.idempotency = string.format("%s: unstable (second pass: %d:%d: %s)",
            file.filename, second.line, second.column, second.message)
    else
        local different = false
        for i = 1, math.max(#first.lines, #second.lines) do
            if first.lines[i] ~= second.lines[i] then different = i; break end
        end
        file.idempotency = file.filename .. (different and ": unstable at line " .. different or ": stable")
    end
    for i, line in ipairs(first.lines) do
        if #line > profile.width then
            file.diagnostics[#file.diagnostics + 1] = string.format("%s:%d: warning: line too long (%d > %d)",
                file.filename, i, #line, profile.width)
        end
    end
    return file
end
local profiles, profile = {}, false
local numeric = { width = true, indent = true, max_blank_lines = true, comment_column = true }
for line in io.lines("input/style.txt") do
    local name = line:match("^%[(.+)%]$")
    if name then profile = {}; profiles[name] = profile
    elseif line ~= "" then
        local key, value = line:match("^([^=]+)=(.*)$")
        if numeric[key] then value = tonumber(value)
        elseif key ~= "brace_style" then value = value == "yes" end
        profile[key] = value
    end
end
local files, file = {}, false
for line in io.lines("input/sources.txt") do
    local filename, name = line:match("^=== ([^ ]+) ([^ ]+)$")
    if filename then
        file = { header = line, filename = filename, profile = name, lines = {} }
        files[#files + 1] = file
    else file.lines[#file.lines + 1] = line end
end
local formatted, idempotency, diagnostics, trees, changes = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local function append(target, source)
    for _, line in ipairs(source) do target[#target + 1] = line end
end
for _, source in ipairs(files) do
    local result = format(source, profiles[source.profile])
    formatted[#formatted + 1] = source.header
    append(formatted, result.formatted)
    idempotency[#idempotency + 1] = result.idempotency
    append(diagnostics, result.diagnostics)
    trees[#trees + 1], changes[#changes + 1] = "=== " .. source.filename, "=== " .. source.filename
    if result.error then
        trees[#trees + 1], changes[#changes + 1] = "syntax error", "skipped (syntax error)"
    else
        local first, longest, broken, forced = result.first, 0, 0, 0
        for _, line in ipairs(first.lines) do longest = math.max(longest, #line) end
        local groups = D.groups(first.document)
        for _, group in ipairs(groups) do
            if group.mode == "break" or group.mode == "forced" then broken = broken + 1 end
            if group.mode == "forced" then forced = forced + 1 end
        end
        trees[#trees + 1] = string.format("metrics lines=%d longest=%d comments=%d groups=%d broken=%d forced=%d",
            #first.lines, longest, #first.comments, #groups, broken, forced)
        if first.first_doc then
            trees[#trees + 1] = "function " .. first.first_name
            append(trees, report.tree(first.first_doc))
        else trees[#trees + 1] = "no function" end
        append(changes, report.diff(result.original, result.formatted))
    end
end
if #diagnostics == 0 then diagnostics[1] = "no diagnostics" end
local function write(filename, lines)
    local target = assert(io.open("output/" .. filename, "w"))
    if #lines > 0 then target:write(table.concat(lines, "\n"), "\n") end
    target:close()
end
write("formatted.txt", formatted)
write("idempotency.txt", idempotency)
write("diagnostics.txt", diagnostics)
write("doc_tree.txt", trees)
write("changes.txt", changes)

local lexer = require("lexer")
local P = {}
P.__index = P
local precedence = { ["||"] = 1, ["&&"] = 2, ["=="] = 3, ["!="] = 3,
    ["<"] = 4, ["<="] = 4, [">"] = 4, [">="] = 4, ["+"] = 5, ["-"] = 5,
    ["*"] = 6, ["/"] = 6, ["%"] = 6 }
local function node(tag, first, props)
    props = props or {}
    props.tag, props.first = tag, first
    return props
end

function P:peek() return self.tokens[self.cursor] end
function P:at(symbol) return self:peek().text == symbol end
function P:fail(expected)
    local actual = self:peek()
    local found = actual.kind == "end" and "end of file" or "'" .. actual.text .. "'"
    lexer.fail(actual.line, actual.column, "expected " .. expected .. ", found " .. found)
end
function P:take(symbol)
    if not self:at(symbol) then self:fail("'" .. symbol .. "'") end
    local tok = self:peek()
    self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
    return tok
end
function P:identifier()
    if self:peek().kind ~= "identifier" then self:fail("identifier") end
    local tok = self:peek()
    self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
    return tok
end
function P:typ()
    if not lexer.types[self:peek().text] then self:fail("type") end
    local tok = self:peek()
    self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
    return tok
end

function P:item()
    local typ, name = self:typ(), self:identifier()
    typ.allowed = true
    if self:at("(") then
        local parameters = self:list("(", ")", P.parameter, false)
        return node("function", typ, { typ = typ, name = name, parameters = parameters, body = self:block() })
    end
    return self:variable(typ, name, true)
end
function P:parameter()
    local typ, name = self:typ(), self:identifier()
    local brackets = {}
    while self:at("[") do brackets[#brackets + 1] = { self:take("["), self:take("]") } end
    return node("parameter", typ, { typ = typ, name = name, brackets = brackets })
end
function P:variable(typ, name, semicolon)
    local dimensions = {}
    while self:at("[") do
        local left = self:take("[")
        local expr = not self:at("]") and self:expression() or false
        dimensions[#dimensions + 1] = { left, expr, self:take("]") }
    end
    local equals = self:at("=") and self:take("=") or false
    local initializer = equals and self:initializer() or false
    local semi = semicolon and self:take(";") or false
    return node("variable", typ, { typ = typ, name = name, dimensions = dimensions,
        equals = equals, initializer = initializer, semi = semi })
end
function P:initializer()
    if self:at("{") then return self:list("{", "}", P.initializer, true) end
    return self:expression()
end
function P:list(opening, closing, element, trailing)
    local left = self:take(opening)
    local elements, commas, final = {}, {}, false
    if not self:at(closing) then
        elements[1] = element(self)
        elements[1].first.allowed = true
        while self:at(",") do
            local comma = self:take(",")
            if trailing and self:at(closing) then
                comma.trailing_comma, final = true, comma
                break
            end
            commas[#commas + 1] = comma
            local item = element(self)
            item.first.allowed = true
            elements[#elements + 1] = item
        end
    end
    return node("list", left, { left = left, right = self:take(closing), elements = elements,
        commas = commas, trailing = final, role = opening })
end
function P:block()
    local left, statements = self:take("{"), {}
    while not self:at("}") and self:peek().kind ~= "end" do
        local stmt = self:statement()
        stmt.first.allowed = true
        statements[#statements + 1] = stmt
    end
    local right = self:take("}")
    right.allowed = true
    return node("block", left, { left = left, right = right, statements = statements })
end
function P:body()
    local result = self:statement()
    if result.tag ~= "block" then result.first.allowed = true end
    return result
end
function P:statement()
    local tok = self:peek()
    if self:at("{") then return self:block()
    elseif lexer.types[tok.text] then
        local typ, name = self:typ(), self:identifier()
        return self:variable(typ, name, true)
    elseif self:at("if") then return self:if_statement()
    elseif self:at("while") then
        local keyword, left = self:take("while"), self:take("(")
        local test, right = self:expression(), self:take(")")
        return node("while", keyword, { keyword = keyword, left = left, test = test,
            right = right, body = self:body() })
    elseif self:at("for") then return self:for_statement()
    elseif self:at("switch") then return self:switch_statement()
    elseif self:at("return") then
        local keyword = self:take("return")
        local expr = not self:at(";") and self:expression() or false
        return node("return", keyword, { keyword = keyword, expr = expr, semi = self:take(";") })
    elseif self:at("break") or self:at("continue") then
        self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
        return node("flow", tok, { keyword = tok, semi = self:take(";") })
    end
    local value = self:simple()
    return node("simple_stmt", value.first, { value = value, semi = self:take(";") })
end
function P:if_statement()
    local keyword, left = self:take("if"), self:take("(")
    local test, right = self:expression(), self:take(")")
    local body = self:body()
    local else_token = self:at("else") and self:take("else") or false
    local alternative = false
    if else_token then
        if self:at("if") then
            alternative = self:if_statement()
            alternative.first.allowed = false
        else alternative = self:body() end
    end
    return node("if", keyword, { keyword = keyword, left = left, test = test, right = right,
        body = body, else_token = else_token, alternative = alternative })
end
function P:for_statement()
    local keyword, left = self:take("for"), self:take("(")
    local initial = false
    if not self:at(";") then
        if lexer.types[self:peek().text] then
            local typ, name = self:typ(), self:identifier()
            initial = self:variable(typ, name, false)
        else initial = self:simple() end
    end
    local first_semi = self:take(";")
    local condition = not self:at(";") and self:expression() or false
    local second_semi = self:take(";")
    local update = not self:at(")") and self:simple() or false
    local right = self:take(")")
    return node("for", keyword, { keyword = keyword, left = left, initial = initial,
        first_semi = first_semi, condition = condition, second_semi = second_semi,
        update = update, right = right, body = self:body() })
end
function P:switch_statement()
    local keyword, left = self:take("switch"), self:take("(")
    local test, right = self:expression(), self:take(")")
    local opening, clauses = self:take("{"), {}
    while self:at("case") or self:at("default") do
        local label = self:peek()
        self.cursor, label.allowed = self.cursor + 1, true
        local value = label.text == "case" and self:expression() or false
        local colon, statements = self:take(":"), {}
        while not self:at("case") and not self:at("default") and not self:at("}") and self:peek().kind ~= "end" do
            local stmt = self:statement()
            stmt.first.allowed = true
            statements[#statements + 1] = stmt
        end
        clauses[#clauses + 1] = node("clause", label,
            { label = label, value = value, colon = colon, statements = statements })
    end
    local closing = self:take("}")
    closing.allowed = true
    return node("switch", keyword, { keyword = keyword, left = left, test = test, right = right,
        opening = opening, closing = closing, clauses = clauses })
end
function P:simple()
    local left = self:expression()
    if lexer.assignment[self:peek().text] then
        local op = self:peek()
        self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
        return node("assign", left.first, { left = left, op = op, right = self:expression() })
    end
    return node("expr_stmt", left.first, { expr = left })
end
function P:expression()
    local test = self:binary(1)
    if not self:at("?") then return test end
    local question, yes = self:take("?"), self:expression()
    local colon, no = self:take(":"), self:expression()
    return node("conditional", test.first, { test = test, question = question, yes = yes,
        colon = colon, no = no, level = 0 })
end
function P:binary(level)
    if level > 6 then return self:unary() end
    local left = self:binary(level + 1)
    while precedence[self:peek().text] == level do
        local op = self:peek()
        self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
        left = node("binary", left.first, { left = left, op = op,
            right = self:binary(level + 1), level = level })
    end
    return left
end
function P:unary()
    if self:at("-") or self:at("!") then
        local op = self:peek()
        self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
        return node("unary", op, { op = op, operand = self:unary(), level = 7 })
    end
    local target = self:primary()
    while true do
        if self:at("(") then
            target = node("call", target.first, { target = target,
                arguments = self:list("(", ")", P.expression, false), level = 8 })
        elseif self:at("[") then
            local left, index = self:take("["), self:expression()
            target = node("index", target.first, { target = target, left = left, index = index,
                right = self:take("]"), level = 8 })
        elseif self:at(".") then
            local dot, member = self:take("."), self:identifier()
            target = node("member", target.first, { target = target, dot = dot, member = member, level = 8 })
        else break end
    end
    return target
end
function P:primary()
    local tok = self:peek()
    if tok.kind == "identifier" or tok.kind == "number" or tok.kind == "string" or tok.text == "true" or tok.text == "false" then
        self.cursor = self.cursor + 1
        return node("primary", tok, { value = tok, level = 8 })
    elseif self:at("(") then
        local left, inner = self:take("("), self:expression()
        return node("paren", left, { left = left, inner = inner, right = self:take(")"), level = 8 })
    end
    self:fail("expression")
end

return function(tokens)
    local parser = setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, cursor = 1 }, P)
    local items = {}
    while parser:peek().kind ~= "end" do items[#items + 1] = parser:item() end
    return items
end

local M = {}
local function push_children(stack, indent, mode, doc)
    for i = #doc.items, 1, -1 do stack[#stack + 1] = { indent, mode, doc.items[i] } end
end

local function fits(remaining, candidate, rest)
    if remaining < 0 then return false end
    local stack, next_rest = { candidate }, #rest
    while true do
        if #stack == 0 then
            if next_rest == 0 then return true end
            stack[1], next_rest = rest[next_rest], next_rest - 1
        end
        local entry = table.remove(stack)
        local indent, mode, doc = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
        local kind = doc.kind
        if kind == "text" then remaining = remaining - #doc.value
        elseif kind == "if_break" then remaining = remaining - #(mode == "break" and doc.broken or doc.flat)
        elseif kind == "line" then
            if mode == "break" then return true end
            remaining = remaining - 1
        elseif kind == "softline" then
            if mode == "break" then return true end
        elseif kind == "hardline" then return true
        elseif kind == "concat" then push_children(stack, indent, mode, doc)
        elseif kind == "group" then
            stack[#stack + 1] = { indent, doc.forced and "break" or mode, doc.child }
        elseif kind == "nest" or kind == "align" then
            stack[#stack + 1] = { indent, mode, doc.child }
        end
        if remaining < 0 then return false end
    end
end

function M.layout(document, profile)
    local result, pending = {}, {}
    local current = ""
    local stack = { { 0, "break", document } }
    local function finish()
        local output = current:gsub(" +$", "")
        if #pending > 0 then
            local comment = table.concat(pending, " ")
            local column = profile.comment_column
            if column > 0 and #output < column - 1 and column - 1 + #comment <= profile.width then
                output = output .. string.rep(" ", column - 1 - #output) .. comment
            else output = output .. " " .. comment end
            pending = {}
        end
        result[#result + 1] = output
    end
    while #stack > 0 do
        local entry = table.remove(stack)
        local indent, mode, doc = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
        local kind = doc.kind
        if kind == "text" then current = current .. doc.value
        elseif kind == "if_break" then current = current .. (mode == "break" and doc.broken or doc.flat)
        elseif kind == "line" and mode == "flat" then current = current .. " "
        elseif kind == "hardline" or ((kind == "line" or kind == "softline") and mode == "break") then
            finish()
            current = string.rep(" ", indent)
        elseif kind == "concat" then push_children(stack, indent, mode, doc)
        elseif kind == "nest" then stack[#stack + 1] = { indent + doc.amount, mode, doc.child }
        elseif kind == "align" then stack[#stack + 1] = { #current, mode, doc.child }
        elseif kind == "suffix" then pending[#pending + 1] = doc.value
        elseif kind == "group" then
            local selected
            if mode == "flat" then selected = "flat"
            elseif doc.forced then selected = "forced"
            elseif fits(profile.width - #current, { indent, "flat", doc.child }, stack) then selected = "flat"
            else selected = "break" end
            doc.mode = selected
            stack[#stack + 1] = { indent, selected == "flat" and "flat" or "break", doc.child }
        end
    end
    finish()
    return result
end

return M

local M = {}
function M.tree(document, result, depth)
    result, depth = result or {}, depth or 0
    local kind, prefix = document.kind, string.rep("  ", depth)
    if kind == "concat" then
        for _, child in ipairs(document.items) do M.tree(child, result, depth) end
        return result
    end
    local description = kind
    if kind == "text" or kind == "suffix" then description = kind .. ' "' .. document.value .. '"'
    elseif kind == "if_break" then description = 'if_break "' .. document.broken .. '" "' .. document.flat .. '"'
    elseif kind == "group" then description = "group " .. document.mode
    elseif kind == "nest" then description = "nest " .. document.amount end
    result[#result + 1] = prefix .. description
    if document.child then M.tree(document.child, result, depth + 1) end
    return result
end

function M.diff(original, formatted)
    local n, m, dp = #original, #formatted, {}
    for i = 1, n + 1 do
        dp[i] = {}
        for j = 1, m + 1 do dp[i][j] = 0 end
    end
    for i = n, 1, -1 do
        for j = m, 1, -1 do
            if original[i] == formatted[j] then dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i + 1][j + 1]
            else dp[i][j] = math.max(dp[i + 1][j], dp[i][j + 1]) end
        end
    end
    local i, j, deleted, inserted = 1, 1, 0, 0
    local hunks, current = {}, false
    local function finish()
        if current then hunks[#hunks + 1], current = current, false end
    end
    while i <= n or j <= m do
        if i <= n and j <= m and original[i] == formatted[j] then
            finish()
            i, j = i + 1, j + 1
        else
            if not current then current = { old = i - 1, new = j - 1, deleted = 0, inserted = 0, lines = {} } end
            if j > m or (i <= n and dp[i + 1][j] >= dp[i][j + 1]) then
                current.deleted, deleted = current.deleted + 1, deleted + 1
                current.lines[#current.lines + 1] = "-" .. original[i]
                i = i + 1
            else
                current.inserted, inserted = current.inserted + 1, inserted + 1
                current.lines[#current.lines + 1] = "+" .. formatted[j]
                j = j + 1
            end
        end
    end
    finish()
    local result = { string.format("hunks=%d deleted=%d inserted=%d", #hunks, deleted, inserted) }
    for _, hunk in ipairs(hunks) do
        result[#result + 1] = string.format("@@ -%d,%d +%d,%d @@",
            hunk.old + (hunk.deleted > 0 and 1 or 0), hunk.deleted,
            hunk.new + (hunk.inserted > 0 and 1 or 0), hunk.inserted)
        for _, line in ipairs(hunk.lines) do result[#result + 1] = line end
    end
    return result
end

return M
